reviews.comment:
Quedada en el tiempo, te salva pero falta que se actualice. No entendí que el playero se haya negado a emitirme factura A diciendo que “el ACA no permite emitir factura A” siendo que uso el vehículo para trabajo y siempre que cargo pido. He ido a otras estaciones de servicio de ACA y si me emitieron. Con ese criterio me tendrían que descontar el IVA que me cobraron y no puedo recuperar. Tampoco está bueno que te cobren el aire, debería ser una cordialidad incluida en el valor del servicio. A revisar eso gente, no me sirve volver en ese caso.

(Translated by Google)
It's outdated, it's a lifesaver, but it needs updating. I didn't understand why the gas station attendant refused to issue me an invoice, saying that "the ACA doesn't allow issuing invoices," when I use the vehicle for work and always ask for one when I fill up. I've been to other ACA gas stations and they issued them. Based on that logic, they should deduct the VAT they charged me, which I can't get back. It's also not right that they charge for air conditioning; that should be a courtesy included in the service price. Look into this, people; it's no use going back in that case.
